purpose: Refuse a push while the fast gates fail (`wsc gates --fast`: schemas, registries, tool rows, strict JSON, Windows paths, doc size, undated "verified", conflict markers).
usage: git config core.hooksPath .githooks   (once per clone; in a game repo with the core at core/: git config core.hooksPath core/.githooks). Bypass once with git push --no-verify and say why in the commit.
when: automatic on every git push, any branch; under a minute, no network.
not_a_verb: git runs hooks by file name; this one only calls `wsc gates --fast`.

purpose: Entry point of the warscape-core CLI: puts the core on sys.path and runs the `wsc` verbs (reg, find, gates, plus a repo's own verbs).
usage: python3 wsc.py <verb> ...   (from a game repo with the core at core/: python3 core/wsc.py <verb> ...; `--help` lists the verbs)
when: every registry change, lookup or gate run; it is the only way into the core.
not_a_verb: it is the launcher every verb runs through.

purpose: One search across every registry (tools, scenarios, assets, UI elements, engine sites, config keys, hotkeys, engine facts; plus the core's tools from a game repo).
when: before writing a tool, probing the game or searching the repo: look it up first (reuse before you write).

purpose: Run the repo gates: schemas, registries, tool headers and rows, strict JSON, Windows-safe paths, doc size cap, undated "verified", conflict markers, line endings, core pin, host tests.
usage: wsc gates [--fast] [--only name,name] [--json OUT] [-q]   (exit 1 when any gate fails; warnings never fail)
when: before every push (the pre-push hook runs --fast), in CI on every push and PR (full set), and after any change to a registry, tool or doc.

purpose: Change, check and render registries (JSONL + JSON Schema + generated Markdown view): add a row, set fields, check everything, re-render views.
usage: wsc reg add <reg> key=value key:=<json> ... | wsc reg add tools <path>... [--id ID] [--status S] [--missing] | wsc reg set <reg> <id> key=value key:=null ... | wsc reg check [<reg>...] | wsc reg render [<reg>...]
when: whenever a registry fact changes (a new tool, scenario, asset, engine site, fact ...); `check` runs in the gates; `render` after a hand edit of a JSONL or a merge.
